topic: Superposition and Quantum States: The Architecture of Reality
target_audience: Undergraduate science students or scientifically curious high schoolers

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Classical vs. Quantum Divide
lecture_lines: Classical states are either here or there.
Quantum states represent possibilities as a vector.
We call this quantum state vector, |ψ>.
Think of a coin blurring between heads and tails.
Quantum reality exists as a multi-dimensional mathematical space.

Transform classical bit into a superposition Dot (color #00FF00).
Display coefficients alpha and beta next to Dot.
Highlight superposition Dot with a pulsating glow effect using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/coin.svg] as the base element.

sections.title: Defining Superposition: The Linear Combination
lecture_lines: The state is a sum: |ψ> equals α|0> plus β|1>.
Visualize this arrow pointing anywhere on a sphere.
Like a chord blending notes C, E, and G.
The state lives on the Bloch sphere surface.
animations: Initialize state vector |psi> as a vertical vector.
Draw two basis states |0> and |1> in light gray (#D3D3D3) using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sphere.svg].
Animate alpha and beta as scalar weights on basis vectors.
Sum these components to show vector |psi> orientation.
Flash final combined vector |psi> to emphasize linear combination using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/piano.svg].

sections.title: Visualizing Probability Amplitudes
lecture_lines: Amplitudes squared give us probability densities.
Waves interfere, reinforcing or canceling outcomes.
A robot explores every maze path simultaneously.
animations: Draw a unit circle centered at origin (color #FFFFFF) representing the workspace of a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/robot.svg].
Represent probability amplitudes as complex numbers on the plane.
Fade in phasor arrows (color #FFFF00) rotating for phase visualization.
Highlight the modulus squared as the area of a sector.
Sync sector area change with rotating phasor arrow inside the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/maze.svg].

sections.title: Measurement and Wavefunction Collapse
lecture_lines: Measurement forces the system to choose.
The Bloch vector snaps to one pole.
Schrödinger's cat collapses from both to one.
animations: Show superposition state vector pointing between axes, with a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cat.png] appearing near the vector to represent the quantum state.
Animate measurement operation as a vertical projection onto axes.
Collapse state vector onto either |0> or |1> instantly, with the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cat.png] settling on the final basis state.

sections.title: Conclusion: Why it Matters
lecture_lines: Qubits calculate all possibilities at once.
A quantum computer sees the whole library instantly.
